title: Bare Bones x Dungeons and Taverns [DnT]
description: Simplifies the chart and key textures for Bare Bones
body:
This pack changes the chart and key textures to better fit with Bare Bones.   
I haven't encountered most of the keys in my playthrough. I will probably improve their texture / colours when I do.
